notes.title: Sungame Studio is releasing a new horror game soon!
notes.notes:
Dear RFMIYC players,

We at Sungame Studio are glad to announce that we will be releasing a new horror game, Submarine Terror, on April 25th, 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409250/Submarine_Terror/

[b]Story : [/b]

Several months ago, a sinister shadow claimed the lives of two military submarines, vanishing them into the unfathomable depths of the Atlantic Ocean. Suspicions run deep, pointing to an aquatic entity of unparalleled terror.

Your mission: descend to the perilous abyss in a diminutive submarine and extract knowledge about this nameless creature without becoming its next victim.


[b]Features:[/b]

[list][*]Non-Linear: Navigate the abyss on your terms as you seek to uncover the truth while battling primal fear. Every choice you make shapes your destiny.
[*]Multiple Endings: Your path will dictate your fate. Will you emerge alive with revelations, or will the abyss swallow you whole?
[*]Open-World: Immerse yourself in the unforgiving depths of the Atlantic Ocean, a realm where the line between survival and despair is razor-thin.[/list]

Wishlist now!

Peace.

Julia at Sungame Studio.

notes.title: Refund Me If You Can 2 is coming next week!

Dear valued players,

Peace.

Julia at Sungame Studio.

notes.title: This indie horror Steam game boldly challenges you to refund it, if you can beat it in two hours
notes.notes:
Steam's refund system lets you refund a game if you've played less than two hours, and Refund Me If You Can challenges you to do just that.

While there is a nuanced conversation to be had about Steam's refund system, at the very least two hours is a good amount of time to get a feel for most games. Most developers would generally prefer their game to not be refunded if they can help it, but Refund Me If You Can from Sungame Studio actively encourages you to… if you can beat it in time.

Refund Me If You Can's premise is simple: "One maze, one monster tracking you down, will you have the courage and dexterity to escape this nightmare in less than two hours?" You play as someone called Sarah, and only you (the player) can wake her up from a nightmare she's having.

notes.title: Refund Me If You Can challenges you to beat it in under 2 hours
notes.notes: One clever indie dev has made quite the piece of statement art about Steam's refund policies: Refund Me If You Can. It's a horror game where you've got to find your way through a maze-like sewer while pursued by a monster. The trick here is that it's hard enough that it might take you more than two hours to figure out your escape: Which means that beating the game would take you past Steam's refund window. (If you don't already know, here's how Steam Refunds work.).. Read more.

notes.title: This horror game challenges you to beat and refund it in under 2 hours
notes.notes:
A new indie horror game released today has challenged players to beat it within Steam's two-hour window to claim a refund. Creatively styled Refund Me If You Can, the game puts you in the unenviable shoes of Sarah as she tries to evade monsters in her nightmare and escape a darkened maze. If you did take up the challenge like RPS vid-bud Liam did then you’d have two hours to beat the game, and two weeks from purchase to claim your refund. It didn't go well for Liam, as you can see in the video below.
